title: Insurance Sales Executive
description:
Insurance Sales Executive - Dartford - Up to £35,000 + Uncapped Commission

Join a well-established, Chartered broker in Dartford and build your own desk from the ground up - with a generous commission scheme, a supportive team around you, and all the training you need to thrive.

This is a sales-focused role for someone with the drive to build something of their own. Whether you've spent the last year in insurance or in a sales environment, if you're ambitious, a natural with people and hungry to develop - this is a brilliant platform to launch a serious career in commercial insurance.

Salary: Up to £35,000 + uncapped commission
Location: Dartford
Working pattern: Office based

What you'll be doing
- Building your own desk through proactive client engagement and new business development
- Speaking with commercial clients, understanding their needs and presenting the right solutions
- Managing your pipeline and following up on enquiries to convert new business
- Working closely with experienced handlers and executives to develop your technical knowledge
- Maintaining accurate client records and ensuring compliance throughout
- Growing into a fully rounded commercial insurance professional over time

What they're looking for
- At least 1 year of experience in insurance or a sales environment
- A natural communicator - confident on the phone and great with people
- Driven, ambitious and motivated by results
- Eager to learn and develop in a fast-paced, supportive environment
- Someone who builds rapport easily with clients and colleagues alike

Why this role?
- A generous, uncapped commission scheme - your hard work is directly rewarded
- A Chartered broker with a strong reputation and a track record of developing its people
- Comprehensive training and ongoing support - you won't be thrown in at the deep end
- CII study support and a clear development path
- A driven, motivated team with a genuinely good culture
- Real long-term potential for the right person

Ready to make a move? Get in touch - even if you're just exploring your options.

title: Customer Care Manager
description:
Customer Care Manager

Location: Maidstone

Competitive Salary + Company Car + Bonus Schemes

Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00 1 in 3 Saturdays 08:00-13:00

Progression Opportunity Towards Service Manager

Our client is a successful and busy automotive dealership in Maidstone looking for an ambitious Customer Care Manager to lead their Service Reception team and take ownership of the customer experience within the Aftersales department.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is ready to step into a management position and has ambitions of progressing towards a future Service Manager role.

You will play a pivotal role in leading the Service Advisors, improving customer satisfaction, driving performance and ensuring the highest standards of service are delivered from customer arrival through to vehicle handover.

The Role
- Lead, coach and develop the Service Reception team.
- Oversee the day-to-day front-of-house operation.
- Support Service Advisors with performance, upselling and customer retention.
- Manage customer complaints and act as the escalation point.
- Drive NPS, customer satisfaction and departmental KPIs.
- Monitor appointment flow, customer check-ins and waiting times.
- Work closely with the Workshop, Parts and Management teams.
- Identify ways to improve the customer journey and departmental performance.

About You
- Previous Service Advisor / Aftersales / Service Reception experience.
- Strong leadership and communication skills.
- Experience handling customer complaints.
- Understanding of NPS and KPI performance.
- Organised, professional and customer-focused.
- Ambitious and looking to progress towards a Service Manager role.

What's On Offer?
- Competitive Salary
- Company Car
- Labour Sales Bonus Scheme
- Customer Satisfaction Bonus Scheme
- Upsell Bonus Scheme
- Clear progression towards Service Manager
- Supportive management team
- Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00
- 1 in 3 Saturdays 08:00-13:00

APPLY TODAY

If you're an experienced Aftersales professional ready to take the next step into management, we'd love to hear from you.
